The '''Life Zone''' was the region of upper [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]] on [[Oxygen/Legends|oxygenated]] [[Gas giant/Legends|gas giants]] such as [[Bespin/Legends|Bespin]], [[Kril'Dor/Legends|Kril'Dor]], or [[Taloraan/Legends|Taloraan]] that was of the proper pressure and [[Temperature/Legends|temperature]] to support [[Oxygen/Legends|oxygen]]-breathing lifeforms such as [[Human/Legends|Humans]]. On Bespin, the mix of gases that allowed the Life Zone to persist was buffeted and replenished by airborne [[Algae/Legends|algae]].<ref name="CL">[[Star Wars: Complete Locations (2005)|''Star Wars: Complete Locations'']]</ref>

On Bespin, the zone was a 30 [[Kilometer/Legends|kilometer]] band located 150 kilometers inside the outer edge of Bespin's atmosphere.
